gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Technical Reserves reconciliation (At 1 January). Prior year development taken from Managing Agent's narrative and reconciled to the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note. LOB-level prior year movement amounts are from the same movement note (values converted from GBP 1,000s to GBP m). Percentages in gross_premium_mix were calculated from the reported totals and rounded to two decimal places. 'Accident and health' shows a small negative gross premium in the segmental table as reported in the accounts. No named catastrophe events affecting reserves were identified other than the Ogden rate subsequent event which was stated as immaterial.
